title: Florida Health Care Plans
shortDescription: Regional HMO serving Volusia, Flagler and neighboring counties — not a statewide plan.
description:
Florida Health Care Plans (FHCP) is a regional health maintenance organization founded in 1974 and headquartered in Holly Hill, Florida. It is part of AdventHealth, and it operates its own network of primary care centers, pharmacies, and specialty offices alongside a contracted provider network.

The most important thing to know before you filter for it: FHCP is regional, not statewide. Its core service area is Volusia and Flagler counties, with expansion into several neighboring Central and Northeast Florida counties. If you live in South Florida, the Panhandle, or the Tampa Bay area, FHCP is almost certainly not available to you — and a provider elsewhere in the state who does not list it is not refusing it, they simply are not in its network area.

FHCP offers commercial group plans, individual and family plans, and Medicare Advantage. Its integrated model means many services are delivered through FHCP-owned facilities, which can simplify referrals and care coordination but also means network rules matter more than with a broad statewide PPO.

Under Florida law (sections 627.6686 and 641.31098, Florida Statutes), large group health plans and HMO contracts must cover ABA therapy for individuals under 18 with an autism diagnosis, with annual limits of $36,000 and lifetime limits of $200,000. FHCP's commercial plans are subject to these state mandates.
benefits: ABA therapy coverage on commercial plans as mandated by Florida law
Speech, occupational, and physical therapy benefits
Integrated care model with FHCP-owned primary care centers and pharmacies
Local member services based in the service area rather than a national call center
Commercial group, individual and family, and Medicare Advantage options
requirements: You must live in the FHCP service area — primarily Volusia and Flagler counties and neighboring areas
Referral from a primary care physician often required for specialty services
Prior authorization typically required for ABA and other intensive services
Autism diagnosis required for ASD-specific coverage
Services must be deemed medically necessary
Provider must be in-network; out-of-area providers are generally not covered
